description: Bar-parity SECTOR classification of the refuted Frobenius co-Casimir Δ_λ ansatz at the deuteron (H_6, 11 λ⊢6), from the committed rho-k-h3a-co-casimir witness. Finding: Delta_lambda_co_casimir is BAR-EVEN (Δ_λ=Δ_λ' on all conjugate pairs; the norm-type Casimir ∝ Σcontent², not the linear content sum which would be bar-odd). So it occupies the SAME bar-even sector as the binding target; its prediction couples only to a^even and the bar-odd sector contributes 0. The co-Casimir refutation (wrong sign +0.145 vs −4.353) is therefore scope-(a) NUMERICAL, not a scope-(b) sector exclusion — corroborating probe_d_barparity_binding that bar-symmetric ansätze are not structurally excluded. Audit-only; characterises an already-refuted ansatz, proposes no closure (Δ_λ gate).
